gen-righteous-fs-paquito: Paquito sits low and confident, its capitals barely taller than the lowercase. And Righteous bends bold, rod-like letters with diagonals as heavy as its verticals.
gen-silkscreen-fs-rowan: Retro and lo-fi, Silkscreen spaces its blocky letters like spaghetti laid out flat. Rowan follows with generous curves and moderate stroke variation, so a longer stretch feels literary and friendly.
gen-gf-metamorphous-general-sans: General Sans reads smooth and clean, with a tall x-height and one flat line weight throughout. Metamorphous does its best work with soft thick-and-thin strokes and wide sidebearings; General Sans does its best by staying unobstructed.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-public-sans:
Commanding from the first line, Oxanium stands tall on dowel-straight stems.

Public Sans does its best work in the body, with hefty lowercase and broad open counters, while Oxanium handles the heading with bent-arc curves.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-supreme: Supreme reads crisp, with a heavy strip of text through the middle. Paprika scatters expressive, capital-sized lowercase above it, and the two make a bold heading over a solid body.
gen-gf-revalia-satoshi: Approachable and bright, Satoshi runs on a soaring x-height and a wide e. And Revalia does its best as the expressive heading, with widely spaced letters and an open-curved g.
gen-unbounded-fs-trench-slab: Unbounded spreads its friendly, oversized lowercase wide. Trench Slab brings dignity beneath it, with capitals barely taller than the lowercase, which is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-manrope: Expressive and stencil-cut, Snowburst One breaks its tall letters apart with wide bridges. Manrope fills in beneath with bright curves and a marker-like line, so the loud heading gets a friendly, steady partner.
gen-eater-fs-karma: Karma reads trustworthy and classic, with terminals clear of the stem and barely any step up to the capitals. Eater's dark, wide-spaced letters sit above it as a menacing counterweight.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-karma: Expressive and bold, Warnes traces every stroke at one stylus width, with tapering ink ends and stretched tracking. Karma's gently thickening curves make the sturdier partner.
